The Centre for Medical Aesthetics · Surry Hills

Assessed first. Planned in the right order. Then treated.

A doctor-led cosmetic medicine clinic where imaging and a written plan come before any treatment — so nothing is done out of sequence, and nothing is done that should not be.

Book an assessmentHow it works

Assessment first — that is the whole point

Most clinics ask what treatment you want. TCMA starts one step earlier: what does your skin actually need, and in what order?

1

Assessment + imaging

Your skin is assessed and imaged before treatment, so the plan is based on what is seen — not on a single photo or a guess.

2

A written plan, in the right order

You receive a plan that sequences treatments properly, with what comes first and what waits. No treatment is booked before its place in the plan is clear.

3

Treatment, then review

Only then does treatment begin, with review built in so the plan can be adjusted as your skin responds.

What TCMA treats

Bespoke facials

Booking, brought home

Today bookings live on Timely. This page brings them onto the clinic’s own site.

TCMA currently takes bookings through Timely, a third-party booking platform. That works — but it sends patients away from the clinic’s own site before they have even met the team. The concept here is simple: assessment booking, plan information and contact in one place, on tcmasydney.com.au, with no third-party detour.

Inside the clinic

No treatment prices are published on this page, because TCMA plans and prices treatment at consultation. The bespoke facial fee is discussed before you proceed.

Questions, answered straight

Why is there no price list?

Treatment at TCMA is bespoke and consultation-led. Fees depend on the plan agreed after assessment and imaging, so they are discussed before you proceed rather than listed here.

How do I book today?

Bookings are currently taken via Timely, the third-party booking platform shown on the clinic’s own site. You can also email reception@tcmasydney.com.au or call (02) 8074 1559 / 0402 193 101.
